static_traits.name: Lin Kai
static_traits.social_status: 有几位亲密朋友可以谈及个人问题，但尚not yet与他们讨论Unemployment与自卑感；在离职前因压力与同事关系恶化。
static_traits.medical_history: without类似心理问题史；not yet接受过心理治疗；without显著躯体疾病。
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、有条理，能觉察并配合讨论自动化思维；态度积极、配合度高；可表达紧张与Anxiety等情绪；愿意尝试家庭作业与现实检验。

basic_info.main_problem: 我最近被一家without人机公司解雇，我觉得是因为他们认为I am not competent enough。自那以后，我的Decreased self-confidence，对not yet来工作机会感到更Anxiety。
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these thoughts are affecting my self-esteem and stopping me from applying for new job opportunities.
growth_experiences: 在without人机公司承担一个高度复杂、截止紧张的项目时感到overwhelmed，not yet能按时交付；在此之后被公司解雇。该事件发生时压力很高并伴随对失败的恐惧，随后频繁出现“I am not good enough”的想法（尤其在投递新职位时），Decreased self-confidence并对not yet来求职机会Increased anxiety；在离职前因自身压力与同事关系恶化，Unemployment后出现睡眠与饮食规律紊乱；虽然有几位亲密朋友，但尚not yet与其讨论Unemployment与自卑感。

special_situations.event: 被without人机公司解雇的情境
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我错过项目截止或表现not达标，就证明我整体not够好；如果他们认为我not行，那就说明事实如此
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids or delays applying for new jobs to avoid failing again and being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们一定觉得我not行/I am not good enough

special_situations.event: In situations of submitting applications or browsing job postings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一次失败意味着我以后也会失败，雇主都会认为I am not competent enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 减少或暂停求职行动，优先回避应聘以降低not确定性带来的Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我可能又会失败，not人会雇用我

special_situations.event: Facing highly complex projects with tight deadlines
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not能按时交付，就等于完全失败并证明自己能力not足
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Intensifying self-doubt、过度关注失误，导致工作表现进一步受影响

special_situations.event: 与同事互动在Increased stress的阶段
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我表现not好，do not人会看not起我或疏远我，这说明我not行
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 减少直接沟通、在关系中Withdrawal以避免被negate

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized, seen as competent, and to have stable career security
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败与被negate，担心再次被解雇与前途受阻
defense_goal: 通过回避投递新工作来避免再次经历negate与失败，以保护自尊

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的、容易被negate的失败者

manifestations: 拥有几位亲密朋友但尚not yet与其讨论Unemployment与自卑感
在Increased stress时与同事关系恶化、减少直接沟通

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: 在咨询中频繁表达“I am not good enough”的自我评价
对他人可能的评价过度担心
倾向将一次失败全盘归因于自身能力not足
回避与朋友讨论相关困扰

exception_events.target_problem: 在想到被解雇与项目失败的情境中，来访者通常会反复Self-denial并回避投递新职位，导致求职停滞与自信心进一步下降。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在此前的其他项目中曾获得积极反馈并被认可为有能力，这与“I am not good enough”的主导叙事not同，提示其具备专业胜任力。
exception_events.reason: 线索：过往成功经验与同组成员也认为该项目难的事实，为能力与外部因素提供客观支持，弱化将一次失败全盘归因于自身without能的叙事。

positive_force: Positive feedback in past projects shows professional ability and experience
Has several close friends who can provide emotional support
能识do not并接纳外部因素（公司重组与预算削减）对解雇的影响
negative_force: 读心术、预测not yet来与非黑即白的认知偏差
因Anxiety导致的睡眠与饮食问题
Overly concerned with others' evaluations (seeking external validation)

antecedent: 想到被解雇与项目失败
准备投递或浏览职位信息时
target_behavior.core_reason: 对失败与被negate的恐惧；读心术与预测not yet来的认知偏差；将一次失误过度概括为整体without能
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在拒绝与负面评价，短期降低Anxiety以保护自尊
target_behavior.consequence: 求职进程停滞，Career development受阻，自信心进一步下降、Anxiety维持

target_behavior.behavior: 睡眠与进食失调（入睡困难、饮食not规律）
antecedent: 回想项目失败与求职not确定性时
target_behavior.core_reason: 高压Anxiety与Self-denial引发的生理与行为层面失调
target_behavior.function: In the short term, escapes facing emotions and stress (stress response)
target_behavior.consequence: 体能与专注下降，Anxiety intensified，进一步降低求职与Self-efficacy

target_behavior.behavior: 在高压项目情境中的Self-doubt与Anxiety升高，影响工作绩效
target_behavior.core_reason: 非黑即白思维将按时交付视为能力唯一标准，情绪化推理将紧张体验等同于without能
target_behavior.function: Tries to 'force' oneself to perform through hypervigilance but triggers excessive pressure
target_behavior.consequence: 绩效下降、Interpersonal relationships恶化，增加被负面评价与解雇的风险
